title: PerfDojo: Automated ML Library Generation for Heterogeneous Architectures
problem: ML model performance tuning requires manual optimization across diverse hardware (CPUs: x86/Arm/RISC-V, GPUs, accelerators) with varying instruction sets, data types, and architecture-specific requirements. Manual approaches are resource-intensive; existing automated methods rely on complex heuristics and uninterpretable representations.
motivation: Hardware heterogeneity (sparsity, quantization, mixed-precision) requires specialized kernels per architecture. Performance portability remains elusive. Need automated approach without requiring deep hardware knowledge or prior optimization expertise.
method: The system automatically tunes machine learning code using large language models (AI trained on text) and reinforcement learning (AI that learns through trial and reward). It represents code in a form humans can read that follows mathematical principles, and validates that any changes it makes are mathematically correct. The framework optimizes computation kernels (core routines) for different hardware—CPUs, GPUs, accelerators—without needing you to specify the hardware details beforehand. This keeps the optimized code understandable to humans while letting the AI learn and improve.
key_novelty: This is the first system to use large language models and reinforcement learning to automatically optimize code for different computers while keeping the code human-readable and mathematically valid, instead of relying on complicated hand-coded optimization rules.
contributions: PerfDojo: RL environment for kernel optimization
Human-readable code representation guaranteeing semantic validity
Multi-architecture support (x86, Arm, RISC-V CPUs; GPUs)

metrics.focus: Performance gains across architectures, portability, optimization time

limitations: Abstract only - no specific performance numbers, no architecture-specific case studies, unclear generalization to novel architectures
primary_theme: AI-driven automated performance optimization for heterogeneous systems
